Bash_SubD-Scan.sh Explained

This is an enumeration scrips written in Bash. it is a compilation of tools which scans for sub-domains under a given URL, Creates a folder for each url, a file for each scan tool and puts everything together in a txt file (subs.txt). Later it sorts out the common file and deleting duplicates, Then it starts sending HTTP/S Requests to the found sub-domains, and puts the ones who responde in a seperate file. atlast it searches for any link with information on the programming language of the active sub-domains and put them in a seperate file.

Python_final_project.py Explained

This script asks the user for an HTTP/S link, Fixes it into an IP address, And sends ping to the website. if it was found available - it starts a tcp scan, and if port 22 (SSH) was found open it offers you to attempt brute-force attack for login credentials. If it found the correct credentials - it prints them, shows connection options and offers to send commands to the remote server, Please use it ONLY for legal purposes, it's up to you.
